description:
`jit validate` rejects every repository whose event log holds a `profile_applied` line, because the event was retired without its tag joining the tags readers skip. Three of the four known logs are unaffected by chance; gf2 holds five such lines and cannot pass whole-repository validation.

## Background

The record-fidelity pass accepts a line outside the current event vocabulary only when its tag is listed as retired. `profile_applied` was written by earlier versions and later removed from the vocabulary. A census of the event tags on every branch of the four known repositories finds it to be the only removed tag missing from the list.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Record-fidelity validation reports no drift for a `profile_applied` event line.
- [hard] REQ-02: A tag that is neither cataloged nor retired is still reported as unknown.
title: Accept retired profile_applied event lines in record fidelity
